description: Full configuration surface for the Community Contribution Loop: master enable/disable, per-category auto-approve thresholds (bug-report/pr/scenario), attribution config (anonymous default with opt-in name/handle/contact), private-repo override toggle. Reads/writes the same settings store as the onboarding prompt. Must be reachable from the onboarding 'customize' link and from a top-level settings page.
name: contribution-settings-surface
title: Build contribution settings surface
